en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rocky stream running through a forested canyon. Tall, leafless trees stand on the left, and a large rock face dominates the right side. The water flows over and between boulders in the foreground. Sepia-toned printing with captions in red ink surrounds the image, including the title at the bottom and publisher and printing notes along the sides. A red number appears in the lower-right corner.
